about: AURIX's honest catalog of ways to make or save money. Every dollar figure is a rough ESTIMATE from general knowledge (not verified, not a promise): check current rates before acting. 'confidence' is how proven the idea is for a solo person with these skills (0.1 = long shot, 0.8 = well established). 'gate' is what only the owner can do or must approve. Nothing here moves real money or creates an account on its own.

items.name: Put idle cash in a high-yield account or T-bills
items.summary: Cash sitting in a normal checking account earns ~0%. High-yield savings and Treasury bills have paid roughly 4-5% a year recently.
items.aurix_does: Compares current public rates from official pages (read-only) and reminds you monthly.
items.you_do: Open the account and move the money yourself.
items.first_step: Check what your cash earns today.

items.name: Subscription and bills audit
items.summary: Most households pay for things they forgot. Cancelling or downgrading is guaranteed income.
items.aurix_does: Builds a checklist from what you tell it and tracks renewal dates in your to-dos.
items.first_step: List every recurring charge from the last 3 statements.

items.name: Steady index investing (the benchmark)
items.summary: Buy a broad index fund every month and do nothing clever. Long-run stock returns have averaged high single digits, with big drops on the way. Every other investing idea has to beat this after costs.
items.aurix_does: Paper-tracks it in the strategy lab as 'Buy & hold SPY' and tells you honestly whether anything beats it.
items.you_do: Choose a broker and set up automatic buys. AURIX never trades real money.
items.gate: real-money investing is your decision, not AURIX's
items.first_step: Decide a monthly amount you would never need back for 10 years.

items.name: Paper strategy lab (evidence before any real risk)
items.summary: Eleven textbook strategies, backtested with costs and no look-ahead, then tracked live on paper next to SPY. Most will not beat buy-and-hold; that is the point of testing.
items.aurix_does: Runs daily after the market closes, reports honestly, and marks anything that only worked in-sample as probably luck.
items.you_do: Read the leaderboard; decide if anything earns real money after months of live results.

items.name: Rent your PC's idle GPU
items.summary: Marketplaces such as Vast.ai or Salad pay for spare GPU time. Earnings depend heavily on the card and demand; electricity and wear eat some of it.
items.aurix_does: Reads public pricing pages to estimate what your card would earn and helps you compare.
items.you_do: Install the provider's software yourself and create the account. It runs third-party workloads on your gaming PC, so decide if you are comfortable.
items.gate: installing third-party software on your PC
items.first_step: Tell me your GPU model and I will estimate earnings against electricity.

items.name: Transcription with local Whisper
items.summary: AURIX already has ffmpeg and speech-to-text tools. Audio transcription is paid per audio minute on several platforms and by direct clients; many platforms restrict AI-only output, so a human review pass is part of the job.
items.aurix_does: Transcribes locally, formats, and flags unclear passages for your review.
items.you_do: Create the platform account, check its AI rules, and review before delivering.
items.first_step: Read one platform's AI-use policy before anything else.

items.name: Freelance small automation jobs
items.summary: Fiverr/Upwork-style jobs: scrapers, spreadsheet automation, small scripts. Real money for real work; competition is heavy at the low end.
items.aurix_does: Drafts and tests solutions in the sandbox for you to review and deliver.
items.you_do: Win the job, talk to the client, deliver, and follow the platform's AI-disclosure rules.
items.first_step: Pick one narrow service you can do well (say, 'Excel to clean CSV').

items.name: Sell 3D-printable models or prints
items.summary: You have a CT-to-STL pipeline and a print-cost tool. Print-on-demand and model marketplaces pay small amounts per sale; a few good niche models can earn steadily.
items.aurix_does: Prepares models, cost sheets and listing text.
items.you_do: Design or pick niches, list them, and handle any physical printing/shipping. Never publish anyone's medical scan.
items.first_step: Find one niche you know that has few good models.

items.name: Resale flips from public listings
items.summary: Underpriced items on marketplaces can be resold for profit. It is real work (sourcing, cleaning, shipping) and fees cut into margin.
items.aurix_does: Watches public listings for items you choose and compares to recent sold prices.
items.gate: your money and time; marketplace accounts
items.first_step: Choose a category you already know prices for.

items.name: Sell spare hardware you no longer use
items.summary: Old Pis, PC parts and gear are worth money now and cost you storage. One-time, but guaranteed.
items.aurix_does: Lists what you tell it about and estimates fair prices from public sold listings.
items.first_step: Tell me three things you have not used in a year.

items.name: Paid data annotation / AI training tasks
items.summary: Companies pay people (not AI) to rate or write examples. Pay per hour is decent for a while; work can be irregular and they forbid using AI for the answers.
items.aurix_does: Only tracks your time and earnings. It must not do the work.
items.first_step: Apply, then see if work actually shows up.

items.name: A niche channel or site (ghost towns, homelab)
items.summary: You have real material (Reynolds Gang research, homelab builds). Ad and affiliate income usually takes a year or more and pays little at first.
items.aurix_does: Researches, outlines and drafts; keeps a posting schedule.
items.you_do: Record, edit, publish, follow platform and disclosure rules.
items.gate: platform account; publishing is your call
items.first_step: Pick one topic and make three pieces before judging it.

items.name: Bug bounty hunting (in-scope programs only)
items.summary: Programs on HackerOne, Bugcrowd or Intigriti pay for valid vulnerabilities. Most beginners earn nothing for months and competition is intense. Testing anything out of scope is illegal.
items.aurix_does: Reads a program's public scope page, keeps the scope as a hard limit, and organizes notes. There is no approved network egress for active testing yet, so it will not scan anything.
items.you_do: Choose a program, test only what its rules allow, and write reports.
items.gate: every probe needs your approval and must be inside written scope
items.first_step: Read one program's rules end to end and write down what is in scope.

items.name: Real-estate lead research
items.summary: Finding homes or steering buyers for a fee generally needs a real estate license in Colorado. Public-data research for your own use is fine; taking a cut is a licensed activity.
items.aurix_does: Public-data research for your own decisions only.
items.you_do: Talk to a Colorado attorney or broker before any fee arrangement.
items.first_step: Do not accept compensation until you have legal advice.

items.name: Crypto trading or yield farming
items.summary: Real-money crypto is off the table under AURIX's rules (and most retail traders lose money after fees). Listed so the answer is written down.
items.aurix_does: Nothing. Real-money trading is refused in code.
